arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test R2: digit field numbering with various format specs
print('=== R2 Tests ===')

tests = [
    ('{0:d}', '42', True),  # Should match
    ('{0:d}', 'abc', False),  # Should not match (not a number)
    ('{0:d}{1:s}', '42 hello', False),  # Wait, {:s} matches whitespace, so this won't match 'hello'
    ('{0:d}{1:w}', '42 hello', True),  # {:w} matches letters
    ('{0:>10}', 'hello     ', True),  # Right-align to at least 10 chars
    ('{0:10d}', '42', True),  # Width 10, type d
    ('{0:.2f}', '3.14159', True),  # Float with precision
    ('{0:x}', 'ff', True),  # Hex
    ('{0:b}', '1010', True),  # Binary
]

for fmt, text, should_match in tests:
    try:
        r = parse.parse(fmt, text)
        matched = r is not None
        status = 'OK' if matched == should_match else 'FAIL'
        print(f'{status}: parse(\"{fmt}\", \"{text}\") = {r}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'ERROR: parse(\"{fmt}\", \"{text}\") raised {type(e).__name__}: {e}')
"
